content: नागर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [नगरे भवः अण्] .²1 Town-born, town-bred. .²2 Relating to a town, civic. .²3 Spoken in a town. .²4 Polite, civil. .²5 Clever, sharp. .²6 Bad, vile, one who has contracted the vices of a town. नागनागरयोर्मध्ये वरं नागो न नागरः . नागो दशति कालेन नागरस्तु पुनः पुनः .. <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²7 Nameless. .{@-रः@} .²1 A citizen (पौर); यः पण्यस्त्रीरतिपरिमलोद्गारिभिर्नागराणामुद्दामानि प्रथयति शिलावेश्मभिर्यौवनानि <ls>Me. 25</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 4. 19</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 56. 17</ls>. .²2 A husbandʼs brother. .²3 A lecturer. .²4 An orange. .²5 Fatigue; hardship, toil. .²6 Desire of final beatitude. .²7 A term applied to a prince engaged in war under certain circumstances and also to a planet when in opposition to other planets (in <ab>astrol.</ab>) .²8 Denial of knowledge. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Dry ginger; खर्बूरं मरिचं पूर्णं देवदारु च नागरम् <ls>Śiva B. 30. 16</ls>. पिप्पली सैन्धवं चैव नागरं च गुडान्वितम् . प्रातर्दत्तं तुरङ्गाणां नस्यं श्लेष्मविनाशनम् .. <ls>Śālihotra.</ls> .²2 A kind of coitus. .²3 One of the three styles of architecture; it is quadrangular in shape; चतुरस्राकृतिं यत्तु नागरं तत् प्रकीर्तितम् <ls>Māna. 18. 94</ls>. .{@-री@} .²1 The character in which Sanskrit is generally written; <ab>cf.</ab> देवनागरी. .²2 A clever, intriguing or shrewd woman; हन्ताभीरीः स्मरतु स कथं संवृतो नागरीभिः <ls>Ud. D. 16</ls>. .²3 The plant स्नुही.
